hero.subtitle: When a loved one is killed in a Novato collision, the days that follow can feel impossible to navigate. LawProactive can connect your family with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death claims in Marin County.

about.title: Novato Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Novato's traffic corridors — US-101, Redwood Boulevard, Novato Boulevard, and San Marin Drive — carry heavy volume through this Marin County city of over 55,000 residents, and the most recent full year on record included two traffic deaths alongside 153 injury collisions. Behind each of those numbers is a family whose life changed in an instant. California law allows a spouse, domestic partner, or children to bring a wrongful death claim first, with certain dependents or heirs eligible in other circumstances. These cases can account for funeral and burial costs, the financial support a loved one would have provided, and the loss of their companionship and guidance. There is a two-year filing deadline from the date of death, though claims against a government entity move on a much shorter clock. LawProactive doesn't practice law — we simply connect grieving families in Novato with an independent attorney who can walk through what happened and what options may exist, at no cost to start.

whyChoose.title: Why Novato Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Rules Can Be Confusing
items.desc: California limits who may file a wrongful death claim, prioritizing spouses, domestic partners, and children before other dependents or heirs. An independent attorney can clarify where your family fits before any deadline passes.

items.title: The Two-Year Clock Starts Immediately
items.desc: Wrongful death claims generally must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks considerably when a government entity is involved, such as a claim tied to a public roadway. Getting guidance early matters.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond Medical Bills
items.desc: California law recognizes both financial losses, like lost support, and personal ones, like the loss of a loved one's companionship and guidance. An attorney can help your family understand the full scope of what may be recoverable.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Typically a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have the first right to file. If none of those exist, certain other dependents or heirs may be eligible. An attorney can review your family's specific situation to confirm standing.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a death in Novato?
items.answer: Generally, California gives families two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If a government entity, such as one responsible for a Novato roadway, may be involved, the deadline to act is much shorter, so early guidance is important.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to any criminal charges filed against the driver?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action from any criminal case that may result from the same crash. The two proceed on different timelines and serve different purposes, and a criminal outcome isn't required for a civil claim to move forward.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect us with an attorney?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service, and attorneys in our network generally work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. We're not a law firm ourselves — we simply help connect your family with independent legal representation.
